skill.summary: Batch rename files using pattern matching and AI suggestions

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of skylv-smart-renamer—an AI-powered batch file renamer.

- Supports 12 intelligent renaming rules, including lowercase, uppercase, trim, prefix, suffix, sequence, and more.
- Preview and undo options for safer renaming.
- Triggered by keywords like "rename", "batch rename", and "file rename".
- Designed for efficient organization of files with automation.
